issue_context.title: Template switch not working/updating
issue_context.body: ## The problem I have defined a template switch (see below) and although the template evaluates to `False`, the switch stays in the `On` position. I'm not 100% certain, but I think this issue was introduced in 0.113.1 while the switch was working as expected in earlier versions. ## Environment - Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.113.1 - Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): maybe 0.113.0, but definitely 0.112.x - Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): Docker Container - Integration causing this issue: Template Switch - Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/switch.template/ ## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` ```yaml platform: template switches: all_lights: value_template: > {% set domain = 'light' %} {% set state = 'on' %} {{ states[domain] | selectattr('state','eq', state) | list | count > 0 }} turn_on: service: shell_command.nop turn_off: service: light.turn_off data: entity_id: all ``` ## Additional information
comments:
